text: matchbook ran four tasks over a full session and .tasks/.index/paths.json stayed at {head:'',paths:{},tasks:{}} because the index is built from commits carrying Task: trailers and nothing was committed while a task was active. cairn related still answered, falling back to declared frontmatter targets and labelling the hit 'via declared targets, not commits' — so the feature the memory thesis rests on has not actually been exercised yet.

author: agent
text: confirmed the trailer mechanism is not broken, only conditional. matchbook installed both hooks at 10:51:53 and then committed 0f7b065 at 11:11:17 and bcb358f at 11:46:57 — neither carries a Task: trailer, because prepare-commit-msg exits 0 when .tasks/.active is absent or empty, and .tasks/.active was not written until 14:31:34 when cairn start first ran. So the index stays empty for any repo that commits before starting a task, which is the normal adoption order: init, then a few commits, then start.

author: agent
text: Closed without building: both criteria are dead, for different reasons. Criterion 1 (cairn related returns commit-derived hits) was satisfied in August and logged here on 2026-08-01 — measured again 2026-09-30, the commit-derived index populates in 4 of 6 repos: scrapcycle 254 paths/18 tasks, recipeasier 84/7, cairns 59/4, matchbook 11/1. Criterion 2 (the two-week trial measures the commit-derived path) is unverifiable by any command — no command makes time pass — and is moot anyway after two months of real use. Because Gate.ts counts missing fields and cannot read prose, this task ranked first in the Nightshift idle block for three consecutive kaizen briefs while being unarmable; that is what prompted the measurement. Measuring it surfaced a live defect that IS buildable, now tracked as t-2jppgtktpypzt0: the index populates and then never refreshes, and nothing says so. buildIndex writes head:'' unconditionally (index-cache.ts:22) and head is read nowhere; getIndex returns any cached file without comparing it to HEAD; the post-commit hook refreshes via (cairn reindex >/dev/null 2>&1 &), which discards failure by design. Reproduced in matchbook: cairn reindex exits 1 there (board needs migrate), the hook swallows it, and the index sat frozen at 2026-08-03 while 23 trailer commits accumulated, with cairn related answering from it silently. recipeasier is 1 commit stale the same way. So the reverse lookup this task worried about is not untested — it is tested and quietly wrong in exactly the repos that went longest without a successful reindex.
